title: ‘Lake America’? These Upstate New Yorkers Aren’t Letting Go of ‘Ontario.’
summary: President Trump on Thursday signed an order rechristening Lake Ontario as Lake America, but businesses around Niagara Falls say they won’t be changing their tune.
